name: Nagavali

source.name: Eastern Ghats, near Lakhbahal village, Thuamul Rampur block, Kalahandi district

sink.name: Near Kallepalli village
sink.location: Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: The Nagavali is also known as the Langulya and, like the neighbouring Vamsadhara, rises in the Eastern Ghats near Thuamul Rampur before flowing independently to the Bay of Bengal.
It runs alongside the town of Srikakulam before reaching the coast, making it a defining feature of the district's geography.
